label: Cherry blossom
note: Hanami under Fuji: blossoming cherries along the river, paper lanterns overhead, and petals on the breeze.

label: 1960s psychedelia
note: A 1967 concert poster: a flower of a sun in rippling rings, an op-art floor, lollipop trees, and a blacklight night.

label: Coral reef
note: Corals instead of trees on a sandy sea floor, an old wreck on the reef wall, and the light rippling down from the surface.

label: Chalkboard
note: The forest in coloured chalk on a green blackboard.

label: Savanna sundown
note: A huge low sun over the plains, giraffes walking slowly across it.
